classes.definition_en: An award record keyed by award_key; not a Study or an individual annual funding record.
A funding/application record identified by appl_id and linked to an award; no assumption of additive budget scope.
An organization as reported within a source record; identical labels do not establish global identity.
An original person or organization name string in a stated role, without resolved identity.
A source-reported person name or incomplete name list; not a Patient and not a resolved unique person.
Source-reported city, state and country for an organization; not necessarily the study site.
A grant project-detail record or abstract; not a claim that full grant text is available.
A patent publication described by source metadata; scientific and legal claims are not inferred from metadata.
A reported patent classification code, preserving the source classification field.
A recorded search match connecting a document to a source-provided concept reference; not scientific support.
Unverified source taxon identifier(s) and label(s), preserving combined values without assuming namespace or alignment.
